children.name: Griselinia carlomunozii M.O.Dillon & Muñoz-Schick
children.description: The native range of this species is Chile (Antofagasta). It is a shrub and grows primarily in the desert or dry shrubland biome.

children.name: Griselinia littoralis  Raoul
children.description: Griselinia littoralis, commonly known as kapuka, New Zealand broadleaf or pāpāuma, is a fast-growing small to medium-sized evergreen tree that is native to New Zealand.

children.name: Griselinia lucida  G.Forst.
children.description: Griselinia lucida, commonly known as puka, akapuka, and shining broadleaf, is a species of shrub in the family Griseliniaceae.

children.name: Griselinia racemosa  Taub.
children.description: The native range of this species is SC. Chile to Argentina (Chubut). It is a shrub and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Griselinia ruscifolia  Ball
children.description: The native range of this species is SE. & S. Brazil, SC. Chile to SW. Argentina. It is a subshrub or shrub and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Griselinia scandens  Taub.
children.description: The native range of this species is C. & S. Chile. It is a climber and grows primarily in the temperate biome.
